run_reflection_tests: run the protobuf reflection unit tests to verify message field access and serialization behavior
test_protobuf_message_constructor: test constructing protobuf messages with scalar and repeated field keyword arguments
test_protobuf_merge_from: test merging one protobuf message into another using MergeFrom and CopyFrom methods
test_protobuf_extensions: test setting, clearing, and iterating over protobuf extension fields on a message
test_protobuf_serialization: test serializing and deserializing protobuf messages to and from binary strings
